_note: English display text for progression.json. Keys and gate logic stay in the Chinese file; this file only replaces visible text. Each quote is taken from the English Stardew Valley Wiki archive (WikiTeam 2025-12-18); “…” marks omitted clauses, and list items are joined into one line. source is the Chinese page ID whose English counterpart contains the quote.

mines.title: The Mines
mines.quote: They are blocked by rock debris until the 5th day of Spring (Year 1), when the Player receives a letter from Morris stating that the landslide blocking the entrance to the mine has been removed.

secret_woods.title: Secret Woods
secret_woods.quote: The entrance is initially blocked by a large log that can be cleared after upgrading to at least a Steel Axe.

quarry.title: Quarry
quarry.quote: The Quarry is unlocked by completing the Crafts Room bundles in the Community Center or by purchasing "Bridge" from the Joja Community Development Form for 25,000g.

sewers.title: The Sewers

requires.text: Donate 60 items to the Museum (Rusty Key)

sewers.quote: It is obtained from Gunther in a cutscene the morning after 60 items have been donated to the Museum.

desert.title: The Desert
desert.quote: The desert is inaccessible until the Bus at the Bus Stop has been repaired by completing the Vault Bundles at the Community Center or by purchasing "Bus Repair" for 40,000g from the Joja Community Development Form.

skull_cavern.title: Skull Cavern

requires.text: Reach floor 120 of the Mines (Skull Key)

skull_cavern.quote: The Skull Key is obtained on Floor 120 of the Mines, found in a chest. It unlocks the door to the Skull Cavern in the Desert and the Junimo Kart arcade game in the Stardrop Saloon.

witch_swamp.title: Witch's Swamp

requires.text: The Wizard's quests after the Community Center is restored (or every Joja project is bought)

witch_swamp.quote: The Witch's Swamp is an underground location that becomes accessible after completing the "Dark Talisman" Quest. … The questline to access the Witch's Hut involves two quests, which become available after completing the Community Center bundles or the Joja Community Development Form.

ginger_island.title: Ginger Island

requires.text: Community Center restored (or every Joja project bought)
Repair Willy's boat: Hardwood ×200, Battery Pack ×5, Iridium Bar ×5

ginger_island.quote: When the player completes the Community Center Bundles or views the Joja Warehouse completion cutscene, Willy will mail the player an invitation to come to the back room of his shop. … The boat can provide transportation to and from Ginger Island at a ticket price of 1,000g … To repair the boat, the player must provide: Hardwood ×200 for the hull, Iridium Bar ×5 for the anchor, Battery Pack ×5 for the ticket stand.

greenhouse.title: Greenhouse
greenhouse.quote: It can be repaired by completing the Pantry Bundles for the Community Center or by purchasing "Greenhouse" from the Joja Community Development Form for 35,000g.

minecarts.title: Minecarts
minecarts.quote: The Minecart is a method of travel unlocked after completing the Boiler Room Bundles or by purchasing "Minecarts" from the Joja Community Development Form at JojaMart for 15,000g.

铜矿石.quote: Copper Ore begins to appear on Floor 2.

铁矿石.quote: The Mines (Floors 41 - 79) have a high concentration of Iron Nodes with potential abundance at Floors 71 - 79.

黄金矿石.quote: Gold Nodes in the Mines at floors 80+

铱矿石.quote: Iridium Nodes can be found in the Quarry, Skull Cavern, and Volcano Dungeon.

tool_unlocks.text: Can break boulders on the Farm
